CPI COOLS — FED HOLD STILL FAVORED

July inflation showed little cause for alarm:

 Headline CPI: +0.1% M/M | +3.4% Y/Y 
 Core CPI: +0.2% M/M | +2.5% Y/Y 
 Energy: -1.5%

Prediction markets still favor the Fed holding rates in September at 68.2%, versus 17% for a 25bp
